rows.en:
(I'm going to the school Christmas party
with Alto, but...)

Yo, \p.
Sorry to keep you waiting.

Oh, Alto!
Merry Christmas!
Hm? Yeah.
Come on, you're no fun...
You're just too hyped up, aren't you?
Yeah, yeah. Whatever, let's go!
Ahh, that was fun!
rows.notes: x4: Alto and Nanase scenes, both genders.

rows.en: Well, yeah, it was.
Do you really mean that?
No, really, I had fun. I mean it.
Oh, really? Well, that's good.

I guess with stuff like this, it all depends
on who you come with...
Well, here's to next year too.
rows.notes: Yoroshiku na -> 'here's to next year'; player answers 'Yeah, same here!' (c22627).

rows.en: (It was a fun Christmas this year too!)

(I'm going to the school Christmas party
with Saotome-kun, but...)

Oh, Saotome-kun!
Merry Christmas!
Geez! You're no fun...
Yeah, yeah. Come on, let's go!
Hm? Yeah, it was.
Let's do it again next year, too...
rows.notes: Alto mumbles it; the player asks 'Huh? What?' next. Subject restored as 'let's'.

rows.en:
No, never mind.
Well, here's to next year too.
(Was Saotome-kun's face red just now?)

(I promised to go to this year's Christmas party
with Michel, but...)
Yo, \p. Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas, Michel.

I can't wait for this year's Christmas party!
Let's all have even more fun than last year!
Well, that does sound like fun, but...

I wouldn't mind spending it
just the two of us, you know...
Nah, never mind... Come on, let's go.

Can't believe Alto got tricked into actually
dressing up as a girl. Just thinking about it
cracks me up.

I think so too.
If we could spend next year like this too...
rows.notes: Both versions; trails off, next row continues.

rows.en:
No, maybe next year we should have
a Christmas party for just the two of us?

Heh, just kidding...
Well, I'm counting on you again next year.

(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas, but...
that last remark from Michel
surprised me a little.)

(I promised to go to this year's Christmas party
with Michel-kun, but...)
Merry Christmas, Michel-kun.

I can't wait for this year's Christmas party!
Let's all have even more fun than last year!
rows.notes: Female version; same English as c22691.

rows.en:
(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas, but...
that last remark from Michel-kun
surprised me a little.)

(I'm supposed to meet Luca
at the school gate, but...)
\p-san, Merry Christmas.
Merry Christmas, Luca.

I wouldn't mind spending it
just the two of us, though.
Oh, never mind. Come on, let's go!

I can't believe Alto-senpai got tricked into
actually dressing up as a girl...
Just thinking about it makes me laugh...
It really was a great Christmas~

I think so too. Next year too, like this...
Or maybe next year it should be a Christmas
party for just the two of us?
rows.notes: Both versions. Luca cuts himself off (rainen mo konna fuu ni... iya).

rows.en: ...I'm kidding! See you next year!

(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas, but...
that last remark from Luca
surprised me a little.)

(I'm supposed to meet Luca-kun
at the school gate, but...)
Merry Christmas, Luca-kun.

(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas, but...
that last remark from Luca-kun
surprised me a little.)

(I'm going to the Academy Christmas party
with Nanase, but...)

Oh, \p-kun!
Merry Christmas!

Hey, Nanase!
Merry Christmas!

It feels like the new term just started,
and it's already Christmas...
Time sure flies!

Yeah, it does.
So, shall we head inside?

Really, something like this is nice
every once in a while.
Parties with everyone are fun, huh?

...Though spending it quietly, just two people
together... that's something I dream of, too.
rows.notes: Kept impersonal (no 'with you'): the player asks 'With who?' next, so the Japanese leaves the partner open on purpose.

rows.en: And who would that be with?

Huh?!
Oh, sorry, I should be heading home!
I'm looking forward to next year, too!
Oh, okay. See you next year, then!
(Was Nanase a little embarrassed?)

Oh, \p-san!
Merry Christmas!

Yeah, it does.
Come on, let's hurry inside!

They are! I'm already looking forward
to next year!
Ahaha, you're getting ahead of yourself, Nanase.

Hee hee.
Well, I'll be heading home now.
I'm looking forward to next year, too!
Oh, okay. See you next year, then!
(So Nanase likes parties and stuff too.)

(I'm supposed to meet Ranka
at the school gate, but...)

\p-kun!
Merry Christmas!
Merry Christmas, Ranka.

I wouldn't have minded spending it
just the two of us, though...

Ahaha, just kidding!
Let's go inside!

I can't believe Alto-kun got tricked into
actually dressing up as a girl!
Just thinking about it makes me laugh...!
It really turned out to be a fun Christmas.

Maybe next year, a Christmas party
for just the two of us would be nice.

...Never mind!
Well, see you next year!

(I'm glad I got to have a fun Christmas, but...
that last remark from Ranka
surprised me a little~)
